inputMapPurpose: Plan requests and per-paper review-inputs.jsonl before first handoff/ingest; reported extraction is separate from appraisal. Source requests are conditional on design and permitted scope.

questions.question: What question was actually tested?
questions.requiredCoverage: Objective, prespecification and the precise claim/outcome addressed
questions.interpretationOwner: review author; never worker-inferred human approval

questions.question: Who or what was studied?
questions.requiredCoverage: Human participants versus animals, isolated human tissue or cells; eligibility, setting and recruited/treated/analyzed counts
questions.interpretationOwner: review author; never worker-inferred human approval

questions.question: What exactly was used?
questions.requiredCoverage: Molecule/formulation, route, exposure, schedule, follow-up, product identity and co-interventions
questions.interpretationOwner: review author; never worker-inferred human approval

questions.question: What was the comparator?
questions.requiredCoverage: Control, allocation, randomization, blinding and timing; state their absence
questions.interpretationOwner: review author; never worker-inferred human approval

questions.question: What was measured and does it matter?
questions.requiredCoverage: Primary/secondary/exploratory outcome, instrument, timepoint, clinical versus surrogate endpoint and meaningful-change threshold if established
questions.interpretationOwner: review author; never worker-inferred human approval

questions.question: How large was the result?
questions.requiredCoverage: Each relevant arm, numerator/denominator, units, absolute contrast and uncertainty; within-group versus between-group distinction
questions.interpretationOwner: review author; never worker-inferred human approval

questions.question: What happened to the other observations?
questions.requiredCoverage: Attrition, missing outcomes, adherence, exclusions, analysis population and experimental unit; repeated measurements are not extra participants
questions.interpretationOwner: review author; never worker-inferred human approval

questions.question: What harms were sought and found?
questions.requiredCoverage: Ascertainment method, exposed denominator, follow-up, severity/events/withdrawals and detection limits
questions.interpretationOwner: review author; never worker-inferred human approval

questions.question: How could the design or analysis mislead?
questions.requiredCoverage: Applicable bias, confounding, selective reporting, multiplicity, precision and internal inconsistencies with source locators
questions.interpretationOwner: review author; never worker-inferred human approval

questions.question: Does this apply to the reader or product?
questions.requiredCoverage: Population, indication, molecule, formulation, route, exposure and endpoint matches/mismatches
sourceRequests: paper details plus scoped destination question/product facts
questions.interpretationOwner: review author; never worker-inferred human approval

questions.question: Is this independent evidence?
questions.requiredCoverage: Cohort/study/experiment identity, overlapping reports, follow-ups and replication search scope
questions.interpretationOwner: review author; never worker-inferred human approval

questions.question: Who conducted and supported it?
questions.requiredCoverage: Authors, setting, funding, supplied products and disclosed conflicts without treating funding alone as proof of validity or invalidity
questions.interpretationOwner: review author; never worker-inferred human approval

questions.question: Is the source current and intact?
questions.requiredCoverage: Version/preprint status, access, supplements, protocol/registration, corrections/retractions, check dates and unfinished checks
sourceRequests: dated integrity checks within permitted scope
questions.interpretationOwner: review author; never worker-inferred human approval

questions.question: Which claims does it support or contradict?
questions.requiredCoverage: Explicit guide/outcome/claim links and supported, indirect, contradictory or unassessed applicability; observed data versus authors' conclusions versus reviewer interpretation
questions.interpretationOwner: review author; never worker-inferred human approval

questions.question: What should this change in our understanding?
questions.requiredCoverage: Bounded takeaway, remaining unknowns and the future evidence that could change the guide, without individualized treatment instructions
questions.interpretationOwner: review author; never worker-inferred human approval

caveat: This map is a planning contract, not a full production review schema. Generate and validate the project-specific typed schema, provenance links, explicit scientific state and access serializers before request/ingest. Q01–Q15 remain present across all research designs; document design-specific applicability.
